fields.description: DAMAC District is a mixed-use development within DAMAC Hills, combining apartment towers with a separate office building. The original residential release offers one- and two-bedroom homes, while later broker references also show studios. Shared recreation and work facilities are allocated to their respective components.

overview: Two residential towers sit alongside a separate office component in the launch presentation. Homes and workplaces have different facility programmes, so office-only features should not be assumed to come with apartment ownership. The residential concept combines shared recreation, outdoor spaces and areas for social use.
research.locationNote: The launch presentation places District within DAMAC Hills near DAMAC Mall. Golf and lagoon outlooks are shown as potential views; confirm the actual tower, floor and orientation rather than assuming every home has that outlook.
research.priceNote: The launch sheet starts at AED 1.1m for one bedroom and AED 1.7m for two bedrooms; its office-space reference is AED 6.1m. Property Finder instead shows AED 1.2m, and later broker material includes studios. These references concern different releases or dates; obtain a current unit-specific offer.
research.paymentNote: The original monthly plan collects 20% immediately, 1% a month from months 3 through 42, and 40% on completion. Its quarterly option collects 3% at months 4/7/10/13/16/19/22/25/28/31/34/37 and 2% at months 40/43, retaining 20% deposit and 40% completion. The sheet adds 4% DLD to the initial deposit. Later schedules require separate written confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document states August 2029, shown here asQ 3 2029. Property Finder reports March 2029. This conflict remains unresolved for a particular unit; use its signed contractual programme.

facts.label: Measurement distinction
facts.value: The presentation uses average saleable area for apartments and leasable area for offices. These measurements should not be treated as interchangeable with plot area or a specific registered unit total.

facts.label: Later release references
facts.value: Later broker material lists studio apartments and alternative 50/50 and 70/30 payment structures. Their applicability, incentives and current validity are unconfirmed; they are not substituted for the original launch sheet.
